IT Sales Manager \Cybersecurity | Enterprise Sales | Mumbai
Company: The Closing Gap
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
Employment Type: Full\-Time
Experience: 5+ Years (Minimum 3 Years in Cybersecurity Sales)
Seniority Level: Senior

Role Overview

We are looking for a results\-driven IT Sales Manager \Cybersecurity to lead enterprise sales initiatives and drive business growth. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in cybersecurity solutions sales , managing end\-to\-end sales cycles, and building long\-term relationships with enterprise clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities in cybersecurity sales

  • Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to deal closure

  • Engage with enterprise clients to understand security requirements and propose tailored solutions

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with CXO\-level stakeholders and decision\-makers

  • Collaborate with pre\-sales and technical teams for solution demonstrations

  • Handle RFPs, proposals, and contract negotiations

  • Drive upselling, cross\-selling, and account growth

  • Achieve and exceed revenue and sales targets

  • Maintain accurate data in CRM and provide sales forecasts

Key Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in IT Sales , with at least 3 years in Cybersecurity Sales

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity products, solutions, and frameworks

  • Experience handling enterprise\-level clients and large accounts

  • Knowledge of IT infrastructure, cloud platforms (AWS\/Azure), firewalls, and compliance standards

  • Proven ability to close high\-value deals independently

  • Experience in RFP management, tendering, and large deal closures

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

  • Strong network within IT decision\-makers and CXO\-level stakeholders (preferred)

jobDetails.title: Senior Manager - Software Sales
jobDetails.tagsAndSkills: Market development,Substation automation,Solution selling,Industrial automation,cxo,Operations,Building management system,digital transformation
jobDetails.jobDescription:
Role Overview This role is responsible for driving growth of Schneider Electric s software and digital solutions portfolio across India, including Energy, Industrial and Building segments. The position focuses on leading consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and positioning software as a key driver of digital transformation, operational efficiency and sustainability outcomes. Key Software Areas Energy: PME, EPO, ETAP Real-Time, Substation Automation (EPAS) Industrial Software: AVEVA Plant SCADA, AVEVA System Platform, AVEVA MES, AVEVA Unified Operations Center, EcoStruxure Process Expert, EcoStruxure Automation Expert Building Management System
Key Responsibilities
  • Sales & Business Development Drive end-to-end software sales cycles from opportunity creation to closure across assigned territories/accounts Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities to meet order and sales growth targets Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving Customers, Consultants, Contractors, EcoXpert Partners, System Integrators etc.
  • Consultative & Solution Selling Understand customer business challenges and position software-led solutions (digital twin, analytics, automation) as business enablers Drive solution shaping, technical qualification and value articulation Work closely with Region/ Branch Sales, Prescription & Business Division teams for demos, architectures and technical proposals
  • Account & Customer Leadership Develop and execute account-specific software growth strategies Build strong relationships with CXOs, IT/OT leaders, plant heads and engineering teams Identify expansion opportunities within existing and new customers
  • Partner & Ecosystem Engagement Collaborate with System Integrators, EcoXpert partners, Consultants and other channel partners to drive execution & new opportunities Work with internal teams (Regional/ Branch sales, Solution Architects/ SAEs/PAEs, Marketing) to shape winning proposals
  • Market Development Track market trends, competitor positioning and evolving customer needs
Preferred Domain Expertise Candidates are expected to bring depth in at least one domain: Power systems / utilities / substation automation Industrial automation / SCADA / EAE Smart buildings / BMS / energy efficiency Digital transformation / IT-OT convergence
Key Skills Strong business + technical storytelling Ability to engage senior stakeholders (CXO / plant / IT/OT) Commercial acumen and negotiation capability Collaboration across cross-functional teams Learning agility across evolving software portfolio
General Success Profile (What will differentiate candidates) Ability to sell outcomes, not products (efficiency, sustainability, reliability) Comfort in hybrid role (sales + solution shaping) Strong hunter mindset with strategic account capability
Location(s): Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Kolkata/ Bhubaneshwar, Ahmedabad
General Qualifications & Experience Education: Engineering background is a must At-least 5 years of experience in software sales, industrial automation or digital solutions, preferably from the same industry Proven experience in enterprise or consultative selling Strong ability to manage complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders Good understanding of industrial/energy domains and customer workflows Experience working with partners or ecosystem-driven sales models

faqQnA.question: What are the challenges of working as a CXO?
faqQnA.answer: The challenges of working as a CXO include long hours, high pressure, and the need to make difficult decisions.

faqQnA.question: What is the hiring process for CXO jobs in India?
faqQnA.answer: The hiring process for CXO jobs in India typically involves a series of interviews, background checks, and reference checks.

faqQnA.question: What skills are required to be successful in a CXO role?
faqQnA.answer: The skills required to be successful in a CXO role include strong leadership, strategic thinking, financial acumen, and the ability to motivate and inspire others.

faqQnA.question: What is the career progression for CXO jobs in India?
faqQnA.answer: The career progression for CXO jobs in India typically involves taking on more responsibility and higher levels of leadership.

faqQnA.question: What is the job market like for CXO jobs in India?
faqQnA.answer: The job market for CXO jobs in India is competitive, with a limited number of positions available.
